materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. requirements.text: 1. Applicants shall be younger than 25 years old.2. Applicants shall achieve a high school diploma or equivalent
